metadata.name: arbswap
metadata.description: ArbSwap: open, professionally managed market-making vault on Solana

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: B4: the proposed successor accepts; the timelock must have elapsed.

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Applies a previously proposed parameter set once the timelock elapsed.

instructions.name: apply_volatility_params
docs: Admin-only application of a proposed volatility change once the timelock
elapsed. Re-validates the payload and, when the proposal enables
enforcement, requires at least one verified observation so the guards
activate against a real baseline rather than a zero one.

instructions.name: bond_keeper
docs: T3.4: the keeper locks a bond in the quote token. The bond is held in a
vault-owned PDA token account, so no external key can move it.

instructions.name: cancel_admin
docs: B4: the current admin cancels a pending rotation.

instructions.name: claim_keeper_reward
docs: T3.4: the configured keeper claims exactly the accrued reward buckets.
Only the keeper can claim, only the `keeper_*` buckets move, and they are
zeroed, so no vault principal can ever be drained.

accounts.name: keeper_reward
docs: S2-19: the signer's own reward account. Rewards are per-keeper, so no
keeper can claim another keeper's accrual, and `config.keeper` no longer
confers any exclusive reward entitlement.

instructions.name: commit_quote
docs: S2-11: commit a staged quote against the `PriceUpdateV2` account written
by the Pyth instruction that precedes this instruction in the same
transaction. Every oracle, mint-normalization, anchor, ladder, inventory,
flow and capacity guard is re-applied here; nothing is trusted from
staging beyond the payload itself. Any failure leaves the active quote
unchanged (transaction atomicity).

accounts.name: volatility_state
docs: Required, vault-bound volatility PDA; see `UpdateQuote::volatility_state`.

instructions.name: execute_fee_claim
docs: Item 5: releases a previously proposed fee claim once the timelock
elapsed. Moves **only** the requested LP-excluded bucket, and only to the
fixed `config.treasury` token accounts. LP reserves are never touched.

instructions.name: initialize_program
docs: One-time deployer bootstrap. Claims the program admin role so a
subsequent `initialize_vault` cannot be front-run for a mint pair
(the vault PDA is derived from the mints alone).

instructions.name: initialize_volatility
docs: One-time creation of the vault-bound volatility PDA. Admin only. An
all-zero `params` payload selects `DEFAULT_VOLATILITY_PARAMS`.

instructions.name: migrate_quote_state
docs: S2-21A: permissionless, one-time layout upgrade of a legacy `QuoteState`
(865 B, no appended `keeper`) to the current layout (897 B). Only the
account allocation and the appended `keeper` field change: every existing
quote field is preserved byte-for-byte. The appended field is set to the
unattributed sentinel (`Pubkey::default()`); a legacy quote has no
cryptographically established author, so it must never be attributed to
`config.keeper` and can never generate keeper rewards. Any payer may fund
the rent shortfall and invoke this; it grants no control over the vault,
quote contents, reserves, shares, or fee accounting.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds any rent shortfall for the larger account. May be any signer.

accounts.name: quote_state
docs: PDA for `vault` (enforced by the `seeds`/`bump` constraint), the correct
`QuoteState` discriminator, and a supported legacy length. It is an
`UncheckedAccount` because the legacy bytes cannot be deserialized into
the larger current `QuoteState` struct.

instructions.name: observe_volatility
docs: Permissionless: advance the vault's EWMA volatility and jump state from a
verified, fresh, feed-matching Pyth update. Rejects an older or repeated
`publish_time`, so state is monotonic and cannot be replayed. Grants the
observer no authority over the vault or the configured parameters.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: B4: the current admin proposes a successor. It takes effect only when the
successor signs `accept_admin`, at least `TIMELOCK_SLOTS` later. The old
admin cannot be locked out by a typo: acceptance is required.

instructions.name: propose_fee_claim
docs: Item 5: admin proposes a timelocked claim of the insurance or protocol
fee bucket. Nothing moves yet; `execute_fee_claim` releases it only after
`TIMELOCK_SLOTS` and only to the fixed `config.treasury`.

instructions.name: propose_volatility_params
docs: Admin-only, timelocked proposal of the volatility risk parameters and the
activation switch. Nothing changes until `apply_volatility_params` runs
at least `TIMELOCK_SLOTS` later, so an activation or a loosening of the
guards is announced and observable before it takes effect.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: F-17: admin proposes tunable parameters. They take effect only after
`apply_params` and at least `TIMELOCK_SLOTS` slots later.

instructions.name: slash_keeper
docs: T3.4: admin slashes the bond; the slashed tokens go to the quote reserve
and are booked to the insurance bucket. Never to the admin.

instructions.name: stage_quote
docs: S2-11: stage a quote into the `PendingQuote` PDA without touching the
active `QuoteState`. The staged payload is only ever applied by
`commit_quote`, which runs in the same transaction as the fresh Pyth
price update, so the oracle write and the quote commit are atomic.

accounts.name: keeper_bond
docs: MVP allowlist path pays no PDA-derivation CU; the body checks it only when
`min_bond > 0`.

accounts.name: volatility_state
docs: Required, vault-bound volatility PDA; see `UpdateQuote::volatility_state`.
Staging is guarded too so a staged payload cannot be built that the
program would refuse to commit.

accounts.name: keeper_reward
docs: S2-19: the reward account of the keeper attributed to the active quote
(`quote_state.keeper`). Declared after the vault-token bindings so a
mis-bound reserve/config still fails on its own account. Created lazily
(trader pays) only when the quote was committed through the legacy direct
path; the normal staged path creates it in `stage_quote` (keeper pays).

instructions.name: unbond_keeper
docs: p2-T5: two-phase keeper unbond. The first call queues `amount` and starts
the cooldown; a second call after the cooldown releases the queued amount
(capped at the remaining bond, so a slash during the cooldown reduces the
payout). The admin may slash at any time; rewards stay claimable.

accounts.name: keeper_bond
docs: `seeds`), so the MVP allowlist path pays no PDA-derivation CU; the body
checks the PDA and the bonded amount only when `min_bond > 0`.

accounts.name: base_reserve
docs: The vault's token reserves, read to bound the quoted depth to the
*available* reserves (net of the fee buckets). Bound by address.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: B1: the vault's base and quote mints, bound by address, so the program
derives the expected token-unit price from the verified Pyth value and
the *real* mint decimals instead of trusting a scaled keeper number.

accounts.name: volatility_state
docs: Required, vault-bound volatility PDA. When its `enabled` flag is set the
committed quote must satisfy the on-chain volatility spread floor, depth
cap, and sigma kill-switch, and its observation must be fresh; a stale
observation is rejected (fail closed). Required — not optional — so
enforcement cannot be bypassed by omitting the account.

types.name: AdminChanged
docs: B4: admin rotation accepted; the new admin is active.

types.name: AdminProposed
docs: B4: admin rotation proposed (timelocked).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Item 5: the fixed destination for timelocked fee claims. Set once at
init; a claim can only ever send insurance/protocol fees here.

fields.name: max_spread_step_bps
docs: Spec §7.3: max change in `half_spread_bps` per update (step guard).

fields.name: max_update_slot_age
docs: p2-T8: max age (slots) of the stored `update_slot` at update time.

fields.name: edge_window_slots
docs: h3: realized-edge loss window (slots) and threshold (bps of available value).

fields.name: flow_window_slots
docs: Item 1a: flow window length (slots) and one-sided cap (bps of base reserve).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: B4: timelocked admin rotation. `pending_admin` is the proposed successor
(default = none); it must sign `accept_admin` after `admin_activate_slot`.

types.name: EdgeBreakerTripped
docs: h3: the realized-edge breaker paused the vault.

types.name: FeeKind
docs: Item 5: the LP-excluded fee bucket a timelocked treasury claim targets.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Item 5: fixed destination for timelocked fee claims.

fields.name: max_spread_step_bps
docs: Spec §7.3: max change in `half_spread_bps` per update (step guard).

fields.name: max_update_slot_age
docs: p2-T8: max age (slots) of the stored `update_slot` at update time.

fields.name: edge_window_slots
docs: h3: realized-edge loss window (slots) and threshold (bps of available value).

types.name: KeeperBond
docs: Keeper bond (T3.4), seeded `[b"keeper", vault, keeper]`.

fields.name: unbond_amount
docs: p2-T5: amount queued for release by `unbond_keeper`, and the slot it
becomes releasable. `unbond_ready_slot == 0` means no unbond is pending.

types.name: KeeperReward
docs: S2-19: per-keeper claimable reward. Credited at swap time to the author of
the quote used by that swap (the keeper recorded in `QuoteState.keeper`).
Bookkeeping only — the tokens stay in the vault reserves exactly as before
and move only at claim, so the fee split and reserve accounting are
unchanged.

fields.name: max_spread_step_bps
docs: Spec §7.3: max change in `half_spread_bps` per update (step guard).

fields.name: unbond_cooldown_slots
docs: S2-19: `min_bond` is NOT tunable. Keeper-eligibility policy is fixed at
vault initialization so an administrator can never re-introduce a
single-wallet allowlist or an exclusionary bond threshold after the fact.
(The `min_bond` and `keeper` fields were removed from this struct.)
p2-T5: cooldown before a keeper's unbond releases (slots).

fields.name: max_update_slot_age
docs: p2-T8: max age (slots) of the stored `update_slot` at update time.

fields.name: edge_window_slots
docs: h3: realized-edge loss window (slots) and threshold (bps of available value).

fields.name: max_anchor_dev_bps
docs: Max |anchor - oracle| / oracle in bps (Item 2).

fields.name: flow_window_slots
docs: Item 1a: cumulative one-sided flow window, in slots.

fields.name: max_window_flow_bps
docs: Item 1a: max one-sided base flow per window, in bps of base reserve.

fields.name: expiry_slots
docs: S2-37: committed-quote validity window (slots). Bounded by
`MAX_EXPIRY_SLOTS` and required to exceed `grace_slots`.

types.name: PendingClaim
docs: Item 5: a pending timelocked treasury fee claim, seeded `[b"claim", vault]`.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: Pending timelocked parameter change (F-17), seeded `[b"pending", vault]`.

types.name: PendingQuote
docs: S2-11: a staged quote bound to the canonical vault and authorized keeper,
seeded `[b"pending_quote", vault, keeper]`. It never affects the active
`QuoteState` until `commit_quote` succeeds in the same transaction as the
fresh Pyth price update.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Monotonic staged nonce; must exceed `committed_nonce`.

fields.name: committed_nonce
docs: Highest nonce ever committed; makes a committed payload unreplayable.

fields.name: pending
docs: 1 while a payload is staged and unconsumed.

fields.name: base_reserve_at_stage
docs: Snapshots of quote-relevant state at staging time (change detection).

types.name: PendingVolatilityParams
docs: Timelocked pending volatility-parameter change, seeded `[b"vol_pending",
vault]`. Mirrors the `PendingConfig` flow (F-17): the admin proposes, and the
change applies only via `apply_volatility_params` at least `TIMELOCK_SLOTS`
slots later. `enabled` is part of the payload, so activation itself is
timelocked and observable before it takes effect.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: `FeedId` but avoid the type alias because of compatibility issues with Anchor's `idl-build` feature.

fields.name: publish_time
docs: The timestamp of this price update in seconds

fields.name: prev_publish_time
docs: The timestamp of the previous price update. This field is intended to allow users to
identify the single unique price update for any moment in time:
for any time t, the unique update is the one such that prev_publish_time < t <= publish_time.
Note that there may not be such an update while we are migrating to the new message-sending logic,
as some price updates on pythnet may not be sent to other chains (because the message-sending
logic may not have triggered). We can solve this problem by making the message-sending mandatory
(which we can do once publishers have migrated over).
Additionally, this field may be equal to publish_time if the message is sent on a slot where
where the aggregation was unsuccesful. This problem will go away once all publishers have
migrated over to a recent version of pyth-agent.

types.name: PriceUpdateV2
docs: A price update account. This account is used by the Pyth Receiver program to store a verified price update from a Pyth price feed.
It contains:
- `write_authority`: The write authority for this account. This authority can close this account to reclaim rent or update the account to contain a different price update.
- `verification_level`: The [`VerificationLevel`] of this price update. This represents how many Wormhole guardian signatures have been verified for this price update.
- `price_message`: The actual price update.
- `posted_slot`: The slot at which this price update was posted.

types.name: ProgramConfig
docs: Singleton program admin, seeded `[b"program"]` (set once at deploy).

types.name: QuoteCommitted
docs: S2-11: a staged quote was committed and the active quote advanced.

types.name: QuoteStaged
docs: S2-11: a quote payload was staged (active quote unchanged).

fields.name: depth_mult_bps
docs: Indexer hint only: the keeper's depth throttle for this quote. The
on-chain depth control is the per-level `liquidity` plus the
`utilization_max_bps` capacity bound, not this field (p2-T8).

fields.name: window_start_slot
docs: Item 1a: cumulative one-sided base flow within the current window.

fields.name: oracle_price
docs: h3: the verified oracle price (Q64) stored at `update_quote`; the swap
measures the vault's realized execution edge against it.

fields.name: edge_window_start_slot
docs: h3: rolling realized-edge tracker (quote atoms; positive = vault gained).

fields.name: flow_n
docs: Spec §5.9: signed net base sold since the last `update_quote`
(positive = the vault sold base on net); reset to 0 on every update.

fields.name: keeper
docs: S2-19: the keeper that authored the currently committed quote. Appended
(additive, migration-only) so existing field offsets are preserved. It
binds the keeper fee share to the quote version that a swap consumes.

types.name: QuoteStateMigrated
docs: S2-21A: a legacy `QuoteState` account was migrated to the current layout.

types.name: VerificationLevel
docs: Pyth price updates are bridged to all blockchains via Wormhole.
Using the price updates on another chain requires verifying the signatures of the Wormhole guardians.
The usual process is to check the signatures for two thirds of the total number of guardians, but this can be cumbersome on Solana because of the transaction size limits,
so we also allow for partial verification.
This enum represents how much a price update has been verified:
- If `Full`, we have verified the signatures for two thirds of the current guardians.
- If `Partial`, only `num_signatures` guardian signatures have been checked.
# Warning
Using partially verified price updates is dangerous, as it lowers the threshold of guardians that need to collude to produce a malicious price update.

types.name: VolatilityInitialized
docs: The vault-bound volatility PDA was created.

types.name: VolatilityObserved
docs: A verified, fresh Pyth observation advanced the on-chain EWMA/jump state.

types.name: VolatilityParams
docs: Parameter payload for the vault-bound volatility PDA. Admin gated, validated,
and stored entirely in the PDA (no `Config` change). Applied only through the
timelocked `propose_volatility_params` / `apply_volatility_params` flow.

types.name: VolatilityParamsApplied
docs: A proposed volatility-parameter/activation change was applied (observation
state kept).

types.name: VolatilityParamsProposed
docs: A timelocked volatility-parameter/activation change was proposed.

types.name: VolatilityState
docs: On-chain EWMA volatility, jump detector and risk parameters, seeded
`[b"vol", vault]` and initialized once by the vault admin. `short_ewma_q64`
and `medium_ewma_q64` store the `arb_math::volatility` per-second variances
(Q64.64); `last_price_q64` is the normalized token-unit price of the last
verified observation. Any signer may advance this account through
`observe_volatility`, but no observer gains authority over the vault or the
configured parameters.

fields.name: jump_until_slot
docs: Slot at which an active jump's configured cooldown ends (`0` = none).

fields.name: enabled
docs: Fail-closed activation switch. `false` until the admin applies a
timelocked activation; while `false` the quote path behaves exactly as
it did before this feature existed. Once `true`, every quote update,
stage, and commit must supply this PDA and pass the volatility guards.
